title: A Panorama
description: A kinda cool looking panorama I made, featuring my head and Tttrissy69's head. Might make better ones in the future.
body: This pack will add a custom panorama I made. Featuring the heads of me and Tttrissy69. I might make better panoramas in the future. This pack does not need any mod loader and is ment to add a cool panorama and effect any gameplay.
